question: Find the value of ((3.17 + 9. 12)² + (3.17-9.12)²)/(3.17 times 3.17 + 9.12 times 9.12).
solution:
**Given:**

((3.17 + 9. 12)² + (3.17-9.12)²)/(3.17 times 3.17 + 9.12 times 9.12)

**Concept Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a – b)² = a² + b² – 2ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ We have, ((3.17 + 9. 12)² + (3.17-9.12)²)/(3.17 times 3.17 + 9.12 times 9.12)

⇒ Expanding with formulas, we get

⇒ ((3.17)²+(9.12)²+2times 3.17times 9.12+(3.17)²+(9.12)²-2times 3.17times 9.12)/(3.17²+9.12²)

⇒ (3.17²+9.12²+3.17²+9.12²)/(3.17²+9.12²)

⇒ (2(3.17²+9.12²))/(3.17²+9.12²)=2

**Therefore, the required value of the equation is 2**
